meta.title: Generation v1 -- Cold-Start Ad Synthesis, Call by Call
meta.subtitle: Every model call, its real inputs, and its real output -- wayfinder map #42, Round 7

views.label: Style brief + copy
views.note: The two text-only Gemini calls deciding what the ad says and looks like. Round 7: style brief is guide-directed text only, no images.

views.label: Masked background inpaint
views.note: Round 6's fix: the product photo is masked, not re-rendered whole -- this is why label text stopped garbling.

views.label: Review + regeneration loop
views.note: Three independent agents (blend, guide-adherence, feature-fidelity) gate a capped retry back to the masked inpaint step.

messages.label: derive_style_brief: gemini-2.5-flash
messages.note: Round 7: text-only. Input: guide's visual directives text alone -- the guide is authoritative for every dimension it measures (color, background style, contrast); the model only translates directives into concrete language and picks font_personality (the one unmeasured dimension). No reference-ad images anymore.

messages.label: draft_copy: gemini-2.5-flash-lite
messages.note: Input: product_name + client's intention (text) + guide's copy-style/hook-framework directives (text only, no image).

messages.label: remove_background
messages.note: Input: the client's raw product photo (image bytes), untouched.

messages.label: inpaint: black-forest-labs/flux-fill-pro
messages.note: Input: original photo + a mask built locally (build_inpaint_mask: binarize -> dilate 4px -> invert -> feather; black=preserve, white=inpaint) + a prompt from StyleBrief's scene description + intention + explicit no-text/no-duplicate-product rules.

messages.label: plan_layout: gemini-2.5-flash (vision)
messages.note: Input: the background_and_product image above + a text hint from the guide's headline_zone directive.

messages.label: LayoutPlan JSON (product_bbox + up to 4 text zones, 0-1 fractions)
compose_ad(AdSpec)
messages.note: Input: background_and_product image + ElementSpecs built from AdCopy (text) + LayoutPlan (zones) + StyleBrief (font/band/color).

messages.label: final ad PNG (shrink-to-fit text, WCAG auto-contrast, drop shadows)
review_blend: gemini-2.5-flash (vision)
messages.note: Input: the final composited ad image only -- judges visual cohesion alone, never content or directives.

messages.label: review_ad: gemini-2.5-flash (vision)
messages.note: Input: the final ad image + a text summary of every guide directive to check against.

messages.label: review_feature_fidelity: gemini-2.5-flash (vision)
messages.note: Round 7, new. Input: the directive-aligned reference-ad images (ground truth, from reference_ads.py) + the final ad image + the guide's checkable directives. Skipped entirely (no call) if 0 reference ads were fetchable.

messages.label: RETRY inpaint -- feedback folded into intention text (capped, max 2 passes)
messages.note: Fires if ANY of the three gates (review, blend, fidelity) fails and passes remain. Loops back to the masked-inpaint step, then re-runs layout + compose + all three checks on the new frame.

cards.title: Two local, non-model steps run before this sequence starts
items: extract_generation_guide(): reads pre-computed Cox survival + SHAP reports from data/ -- no API call, no image

get_top_reference_ads(guide, n=3): reads the local corpus + fetches real ad images over HTTP, ranked by directive-alignment (an ad must itself embody the guide's top findings, not just score well for unrelated reasons) -- often returns fewer than 3, even 0, since corpus image URLs go stale. Round 7: feeds the fidelity check below, not the style brief.

cards.title: Why masking (Round 6)
items: Flux Kontext (the pre-Round-6 mechanism) re-rendered the WHOLE frame every call -- confirmed live to garble the product's own label text
Masking makes the product's pixels structurally untouchable, not just requested to be preserved -- see docs/generation-failure-modes.md #5

cards.title: Round 7: reference ads moved from input to verification
items: User's own critique: letting 3 images (re-)inform dimensions the guide's statistics already measure risks a small sample overriding a real, larger-sample finding
style-req no longer sees reference-ad images at all -- the guide is now the sole source of truth for every dimension it covers
fidelity-req is the new home for reference ads: checking replication after the fact, not guessing style before it -- see docs/generation-failure-modes.md #9

cards.title: Known limits, not hidden
items: The anti-duplication prompt rule (fill-req) reduces but does not guarantee against a second, garbled product appearing in the open background -- probabilistic, not structural (failure mode #6)
Corpus reference-ad images are currently ~100% stale (reconfirmed live twice) -- fidelity-req is skipped entirely most runs today, the single highest-leverage open gap in this pipeline
